text:
Maya: quick sync — we need to lock down launch gating for the evals side of the toolkit (batching + KV cache recommendations). customers are asking for clear rollout criteria. who can weigh in?
Devon: can we split this into two deliverables: (1) engine/runtime changes (kv cache + batching) and (2) product surface (UI + docs + migration)? i'd prefer phased rollout.
Sergio: +1 to splitting. for the runtime side I want concrete canary metrics. my initial thresholds: median latency change <5% and no regression >2% on critical prompt-set over 24h.
Anya: for prompt sets — we need concrete corp/vertical examples. Acme (SaaS), Retail demo, and Internal infra prompts seems sufficient for canaries. who owns ingestion?
Lia: i can own ingestion and tagging. plan: ingest 3 canonical sets, each with 200 prompts and expected outputs. will add annotations for expected pass/fail.
Maya: @Devon @Sergio propose canary metric list please. i'm thinking: tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, error rate, and a quality signal computed over prompt-set A (beta).
Devon: add prompt-level quality metric (pct exact-match-ish + topk relevance). define clear pass/fail thresholds. also need dashboard widgets for canary vs baseline.
Sergio: implementation note: KV cache profiles will be exposed as `cache_profile` with values `conservative|balanced|aggressive`. runtime must also accept `max_cache_mem` to support private deployments.
Maya: product-facing: minimal UI should be a dropdown for cache_profile, a tooltip, and a link to migration docs. not required for MVP internal canary but high adoption benefit.
Anya: proposed launch criteria draft: (a) 48h stable on dedicated pool, (b) no regression >1.5% on critical prompts, (c) docs + migration guide published, (d) canary dashboard with alerting.
Devon: migration guide owner? @Lia? also need a short runbook for rollback if regressions hit.
Lia: will draft migration guide and runbook. ETA: Tue EOD.
Maya: Acme asked for a 2-week canary window. do we accept that as the default or offer as an opt-in?
Sergio: we can support opt-in long canaries but must gate CPU/GPU and memory. add quota config and enforce `max_cache_mem` per-customer.
Maya: ok action items: Lia -> migration guide + runbook; Lia/Anya -> ingest prompt sets; Sergio -> add runtime flags + metrics; Devon -> canary dashboard + rollout policy; Maya -> doc/launch checklist. commit for next sprint?
Devon: if infra has no outstanding blockers, yes. need a quick infra sync after this.
Anya: one more: need a regression test harness that runs nightly against the prompt sets and posts alerts to the canary dashboard. i'll own that.
Maya: perfect. reconvene Thu 10am to confirm infra signoff and final thresholds. :thumbsup:

Sergio: snippet for runtime API we discussed:
```
PATCH /v1/models/:id/serve-config
{
  "cache_profile": "balanced",
  "max_cache_mem": "4GB",
  "batching": { "enabled": true, "max_batch_tokens": 2048 }
}
```

Anya: example regression alert payload (for alerting infra):
```
{"alert":"regression","metric":"prompt_set_A_quality","delta":-1.8,"window":"60m","threshold":-1.5}
```

Maya: thanks everyone — short notes will go into the roadmap doc after the meeting.
